guideStandardIntro.en: Choose Standard mode when starting a new task. Describe what you want to accomplish, point to the relevant files, and explain how to check the result.
guideStandardIntro.zh: 新建任务时选择「标准模式」，说明要完成什么、相关文件在哪里，以及怎样判断任务完成。

guideStandardExplanation.en:
### How it works

The agent calls tools directly to read and edit files, search, and run terminal commands. It includes Skills, planning, goals, subagents, workflows, and context compaction.

### When to choose it

Start here for everyday coding, file work, and research. Standard mode can also write scripts and process files in batches. PTC changes how tool calls are organized; it is not required for batch tasks.
guideStandardExplanation.zh:
### 工作方式

Agent 直接调用工具来读写文件、检索资料和执行终端命令。包含 Skills、计划、目标、子 Agent、工作流和上下文压缩等能力。

### 什么时候选

日常编程、文件处理和资料整理可以从这里开始。标准模式也能编写脚本、批量处理文件；PTC 改变的是工具调用方式，批量任务并不必须使用 PTC。

guideStandardUsage.en:
### Fix a bug

> Find out why submitting the search form twice makes the results disappear. Fix it and run the relevant tests. Explain the cause and what changed.

Expected output: a code change, the relevant test results, and an explanation of the cause.

### Organize project notes

> Read the Markdown notes in this project. Summarize the agreed decisions and open questions, with links to the source files.

Expected output: a summary with references that you can check against the original notes.
guideStandardUsage.zh:
### 修复一个问题

> 搜索表单连续提交两次后，结果会消失。请定位原因、修复问题并运行相关测试，最后说明原因和修改内容。

预期产出：代码修改、相关测试结果，以及问题原因说明。

### 整理项目资料

> 阅读项目中的 Markdown 记录，整理已经达成的结论和仍待确认的问题，并附上对应文件链接。

预期产出：一份带来源引用的总结，方便回到原文核对。

guidePtcIntro.en: Choose PTC mode when starting a new task. Specify the input files, processing rules, and output format. The agent writes the code.
guidePtcIntro.zh: 新建任务时选择「PTC 模式」，说明输入文件、处理规则和输出格式。代码由 Agent 编写。

guidePtcExplanation.en:
### How tools are called

PTC means Programmatic Tool Calling. In this built-in preset, the agent uses run_code to write a TypeScript program that calls tools through a generated SDK. The program can use loops, conditions, error handling, and concurrent calls where appropriate.

### What reaches the model

Tool results first reach the program, which can filter and combine them. The model receives what the program prints or returns; image results are attached separately. Nested tool calls are still recorded and remain subject to tool permissions.

### Compared with Standard mode

Both modes can handle coding and batch tasks. Standard mode exposes individual tools directly; PTC organizes tool calls in code. The current PTC preset leaves the workflow tool disabled. Speed and token use depend on the task and how the program handles its results.
guidePtcExplanation.zh:
### 怎样调用工具

PTC 是 Programmatic Tool Calling，即通过程序调用工具。当前内置预设让 Agent 通过 run_code 编写 TypeScript 程序，使用生成的工具 SDK 发起调用。程序可以组织循环、条件判断、错误处理，以及适合并发执行的调用。

### 哪些结果交给模型

工具返回的数据先交给程序，经过筛选、计算或合并，再通过输出或返回值交给模型；图片结果会另行附加。程序中的工具调用仍会被记录，也仍受工具权限约束。

### 与标准模式的区别

两种模式都能编程、批量处理文件。标准模式直接向模型提供各个工具；PTC 让模型用代码组织工具调用。当前 PTC 预设未启用 workflow 工具。速度和 token 用量取决于具体任务与结果处理方式。

guidePtcUsage.en:
### Check a set of configuration files

> Check all JSON files in configs/. List missing required fields and invalid values against schema.json. Save a CSV with one row per issue. Include unreadable files in the report and keep checking the rest. Leave the original files unchanged.

Expected output: an issue summary and a CSV report. The program can repeat the same checks, handle individual failures, and collect the results.

### Summarize error logs

> Analyze the log files in logs/. Group errors by service and error type. Show the ten most frequent groups and one example from each. Save the full counts to a CSV.

Expected output: the top error groups and a complete count table. Intermediate data can be aggregated in the program before the summary reaches the model.
guidePtcUsage.zh:
### 批量检查配置文件

> 检查 configs/ 下所有 JSON 文件，按照 schema.json 找出缺失字段和不合法的值。每个问题写成 CSV 中的一行；读取失败的文件也记入报告，继续检查其余文件。保留原文件。

预期产出：问题汇总和一份 CSV 报告。程序可以对多份文件执行相同检查，处理单个文件的失败，再汇总结果。

### 汇总错误日志

> 分析 logs/ 下的日志，按服务和错误类型统计次数，列出出现最多的十类错误，每类保留一条示例。完整统计另存为 CSV。

预期产出：高频错误摘要和完整统计表。中间数据可以先在程序中聚合，再把汇总交给模型。

guideMinimalIntro.en: Choose Minimal mode for a new task. For a comparison, hold the model, permissions, input, and starting workspace state constant across runs.
guideMinimalIntro.zh: 新建任务时选择「极简模式」。做对照测试时，保持模型、权限、任务输入和工作区起始状态一致。

guideMinimalExplanation.en:
### What is included

One persistent shell tool and a fixed system prompt. The built-in preset does not load Skills, planning, context compaction, or the standard runtime context.

### When to choose it

Use it as a baseline for experiments and comparisons. It can still read files and execute scripts through shell commands, but offers fewer built-in ways to manage a long task. Fewer tools does not necessarily make it easier for a beginner.
guideMinimalExplanation.zh:
### 保留哪些能力

仅提供一个持久 Shell 工具，并使用固定系统提示词。内置预设不加载 Skills、计划、上下文压缩，也不注入标准运行时上下文。

### 什么时候选

适合作为实验和对照测试的基线。Agent 仍能通过终端命令读写文件、运行脚本，但缺少管理长任务的内置辅助能力。工具少，不代表对新手更容易。

guideMinimalUsage.en:
### Compare performance on a small bug fix

> Run the tests for this project, find the cause of the failure, and make the smallest fix. Run the relevant tests again and report the result.

Run the same task separately in Standard and Minimal modes from the same starting state. Compare task completion, tool calls, and the resulting changes. Minimal mode performs the work through terminal commands.
guideMinimalUsage.zh:
### 对比基础修复表现

> 运行这个项目的测试，找出失败原因，做最小修复，再运行相关测试并报告结果。

分别用标准模式和极简模式，从相同的工作区状态执行这条任务，对比完成情况、工具调用和最终修改。极简模式会通过终端命令完成这些操作。

guideCordisIntro.en: Choose Creator mode for a new task. Describe the capability you want, where it should appear, and how you will verify it.
guideCordisIntro.zh: 新建任务时选择「创造模式」，说明希望增加什么能力、从哪里使用，以及怎样验证效果。

guideCordisExplanation.en:
### What you can create

Creator mode includes the standard task tools plus runtime inspection, persistent plugin management, and guidance for authoring Cordis plugins and agent presets. It can create a plugin that adds a capability or UI, or a preset that combines tools and prompts for a particular job.

### Plugins and modes

A plugin adds capabilities to DSH, such as a tool, a service connection, or a UI entry. A mode is an agent preset that selects tools and defines how the agent works in a task. A plugin can be included in a custom preset.

### How the result takes effect

Ask the agent to install and verify the result, not just generate source code. A plugin may load immediately or require a restart, depending on what it changes. A newly created preset is selected when starting a new task.
guideCordisExplanation.zh:
### 可以创造什么

创造模式具备标准任务工具，并增加运行时检查、持久化插件管理，以及 Cordis 插件和 Agent 预设的开发指引。可以编写插件来添加功能或界面，也可以组合工具和提示词，创建适合特定任务的模式。

### 插件与模式的关系

插件为 DSH 增加能力，例如工具、服务连接或界面入口。模式是一份 Agent 预设，用来选择任务可用的工具，并约定 Agent 的工作方式。自定义模式中也可以使用自己开发的插件。

### 怎样让成果生效

可以要求 Agent 完成安装并验证实际效果。插件可能即时加载，也可能需要重启，取决于修改内容；新建的模式在创建新任务时选择。

guideCordisUsage.en:
### Add a UI

> Create a DSH plugin that adds a project notes entry to the sidebar. Let me browse the Markdown files in this workspace and preview a selected note. Install it and verify that the page opens.

Expected output: an installed plugin with a working entry and preview page, plus any remaining activation steps.

### Add a tool

> Create a plugin with a tool that reads this project’s test report and summarizes the failed tests. Register it and verify it with a sample report.

Expected output: a plugin with a callable tool and a verified sample call.

### Create my own mode

> Create a “Code review” mode based on Standard mode. Have it prioritize potential bugs and test gaps, cite file paths and lines, and ask before modifying files. Save it as a selectable preset.

Expected output: a custom preset for new tasks. These review instructions guide the agent; permission settings determine which actions it can execute.
guideCordisUsage.zh:
### 添加一个界面

> 帮我写一个 DSH 插件，在侧栏增加「项目笔记」入口，列出当前工作区的 Markdown 文件，点击后能预览内容。完成安装并验证页面能打开。

预期产出：带侧栏入口和预览页的插件，以及仍需完成的生效步骤。

### 添加一个工具

> 写一个插件，提供读取项目测试报告、汇总失败用例的工具。注册工具，并用一份示例报告验证调用结果。

预期产出：可调用的新工具，以及一次示例调用的验证结果。

### 创建自己的模式

> 基于标准模式创建「代码审查」模式，优先检查潜在错误和测试缺口，指出文件与行号，修改文件前先询问我。保存成可选择的预设。

预期产出：可在新任务中选择的自定义模式。审查要求用于指导 Agent，实际可执行的操作仍由权限设置决定。

onboardingIntroduction.en: DeepSeek Harness works in a local folder and uses tools to read and write files on your computer. It can help you research and organize information, create documents and spreadsheets, write code, troubleshoot issues, and more.
onboardingIntroduction.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会以本地文件夹作为工作区，通过调用各种工具，读写本机文件，完成搜索整理资料、制作文档表格、编写代码、排查问题等各种任务。

onboardingCreditDescription.en: DeepSeek Harness charges credits based on the tokens used by models and tools. Add credits in advance to keep your tasks running without interruption. Your balance is only used while the agent is working on a task.
onboardingCreditDescription.zh: DeepSeek Harness 执行任务时，会根据模型与工具使用的 token 量扣除额度。请提前添加额度，避免任务在执行过程中被迫中断。你的余额只会在 Agent 实际执行任务时消耗。

onboardingPurposeDescription.en: We’ll tailor the interface and tools to fit the way you work.
onboardingPurposeDescription.zh: 我们会根据你的选择调整界面和工具，以更适合你的工作方式。

onboardingOfficeDescription.en: Edit documents, organize data, create presentations, and more
onboardingOfficeDescription.zh: 编辑文档、整理数据和制作演示文稿等

onboardingDevelopmentDescription.en: Edit code, debug issues, run commands, manage project files, and more
onboardingDevelopmentDescription.zh: 修改代码、调试问题、运行命令和管理项目文件等

onboardingProcess.en: How much detail would you like to see?
onboardingProcess.zh: 你希望看到多少工作过程？

onboardingProcessDescription.en: This only changes how progress is shown, not what DeepSeek Harness can do.
onboardingProcessDescription.zh: 这只会影响工作过程的展示方式，不会影响 DeepSeek Harness 的工作能力。

onboardingCompactDescription.en: See just the results in a clean, simple interface
onboardingCompactDescription.zh: 只看结果，保持界面简洁明了

onboardingStandardDescription.en: Focus on results, with only the most important steps and actions shown
onboardingStandardDescription.zh: 结果优先，仅展示重要步骤和关键操作

onboardingDetailedDescription.en: See the full process for easier debugging and troubleshooting
onboardingDetailedDescription.zh: 查看完整工作过程，方便调试和排查问题

onboardingSkipDescription.en: You can change how progress, performance, and usage are displayed, or enable Coding Tools, anytime in Profile → General Settings.
onboardingSkipDescription.zh: 你可以随时前往 个人中心 → 通用设置 中调整工作过程、性能与用量展示方式或开启代码工作工具。

onboardingNoCreditDescription.en: DeepSeek Harness can’t start new tasks without credits. You can add them later in Profile → Accounts.
onboardingNoCreditDescription.zh: 没有可用额度时，DeepSeek Harness 将无法开始新的任务。你可以稍后前往 个人中心 → 账号与余额 进行充值。

onboardingSaveFailed.en: Could not save settings. Try again.

loginDescription.en: Sign in to your DeepSeek account or add an API Key to get started. Your projects and files are stored locally.
loginDescription.zh: 登录 DeepSeek 账号，或添加 API Key，即可开始使用。你的项目和文件保存在本地。

browserDescription.en: , then open it in your browser to finish signing in.

timeoutDescription.zh: 请重新登录后继续操作。

platformFailed.en: Could not complete the operation. Try again.

signOutUnknownDescription.en: Could not check running tasks. Signing out may interrupt tasks using this account. Sign out now?
signOutUnknownDescription.zh: 暂时无法确认任务状态。退出登录可能会中断使用此账号的任务，是否继续？

signOutDescription.en: Signing out will not delete any data. You can sign in to this account again.
signOutDescription.zh: 退出登录不会丢失任何数据，你仍可以登录此账号。

signOutRunningDescription.en: Tasks are currently running. Signing out will interrupt them. Sign out now?
signOutRunningDescription.zh: 当前有进程正在执行中，点击“退出登录”，将会打断进程，是否即刻退出登录？

failed.en: Could not complete the operation. Try again.

settingsSignedOutTitle.en: You are not signed in to DeepSeek Harness
settingsSignedOutTitle.zh: 当前未登录 DeepSeek Harness 账号

settingsSignedOutDescription.en: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness to get your dedicated API Key
settingsSignedOutDescription.zh: 登录 DeepSeek Harness 账号获取专属 API Key

signInDescription.en: Use your DeepSeek account to get started.
signInDescription.zh: 登录 DeepSeek 账号以开始使用

profileUnavailable.en: Account details are not available yet.

quotaDescription.en: DeepSeek Harness cannot start a new task with this account when no balance is available. Would you like to top up? You can also top up later in Settings → Account.
quotaDescription.zh: 没有可用额度时，DeepSeek Harness 无法开始新的任务，是否前往充值？或者可以稍后前往 设置 → 账号与余额 进行充值。

description.en: Control how the Agent dispatches tool calls.
description.zh: 控制 Agent 派发工具调用的方式。

maxParallelHint.en: Upper bound on parallel-safe calls running at once within one step.
maxParallelHint.zh: 同一步内最多同时运行多少个可并行的调用。

unavailable.en: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
unavailable.zh: 该插件当前未加载，暂时无法配置。

saveFailed.en: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
saveFailed.zh: 本部署没有接受这些值，已保留供你修改。

invalidNumber.en: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
invalidNumber.zh: 请填数字；留空表示使用默认值。

developerTools.error.en: Could not save. Please try again.

developerTools.description.en: Shows trajectory, code diffs, and Agent preset switching in new chats
developerTools.description.zh: 开启后显示轨迹、本轮代码差异，新对话中的 Agent 预设切换

addCatalogHint.en: Pick OpenAI, Anthropic, Kimi, or another provider from the built-in catalog and enter its API key.
addCatalogHint.zh: 从内置目录中选择 OpenAI、Anthropic、Kimi 等提供商，填入其 API 密钥即可使用。

addCustomHint.en: Connect a relay, a self-hosted server, or any other OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint by its base URL, protocol, and models.
addCustomHint.zh: 连接中转站、自部署服务或其他兼容 OpenAI / Anthropic 协议的接口，需填写 API 地址、协议和模型。

addCatalogExhausted.en: Every catalog provider is already configured.
addCatalogExhausted.zh: 目录中的提供商都已添加。

addCustomUnavailable.en: No API protocol is available to declare.
addCustomUnavailable.zh: 没有可用的 API 协议。

description.en: Limit how long each command may run and how much it may output.
description.zh: 限制每条命令最多能跑多久、最多输出多少内容。

timeoutMsHint.en: How long one command may run before it is terminated.
timeoutMsHint.zh: 单条命令允许运行多久，超时即终止。

maxOutputBytesHint.en: Output beyond this spills to a temporary file rather than being lost.
maxOutputBytesHint.zh: 超出部分会转存到临时文件，而不是被丢弃。

unavailable.zh: 该插件当前未加载，暂时无法配置。

saveFailed.zh: 本部署没有接受这些值，已保留供你修改。

subagentDescription.en: Set Subagent recursion depth, count, and models.
subagentDescription.zh: 设置子智能体的递归层级、数量和模型。

subagentDepthHelp.en: Limits how many levels of Subagents an Agent can create.
subagentDepthHelp.zh: 限制 Agent 创建子智能体的递归层级。

subagentDepthOne.en: Only the main Agent can create Subagents
subagentDepthOne.zh: 仅允许主 Agent 创建子智能体

subagentDepthOverride.en: If a tool defines its own maximum recursion depth, that setting takes precedence.
subagentDepthOverride.zh: 如果某个工具单独设置了最大递归深度，以该工具的设置为准。

subagentMaxActive.zh: 子智能体并行数量上限

subagentCapacityHelpLabel.zh: 子智能体并行数量上限说明

subagentCapacityHelp.en: Total live Subagents under the same main Agent, across all recursion levels. The main Agent is excluded. New start requests are rejected when the limit is reached.
subagentCapacityHelp.zh: 同一主 Agent 下，所有递归层级同时存活的子智能体总数，主 Agent 不计入。达到上限时，新的启动请求会被拒绝。

subagentDepthInvalid.en: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
subagentDepthInvalid.zh: 请输入不小于 0 的整数。

subagentCapacityInvalid.en: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
subagentCapacityInvalid.zh: 请输入不小于 1 的整数。

subagentModelSelectionToggle.en: Allow agents to choose models for Subagents
subagentModelSelectionToggle.zh: 允许 Agent 为子智能体选择模型

subagentModelSelectionChoose.en: When enabled, agents can choose a provider, model, and reasoning effort for each Subagent from the authorized models below. Applies only to new sessions.
subagentModelSelectionChoose.zh: 开启后，Agent 可以从下方授权模型中，为每个子智能体选择提供方、模型和推理强度。仅影响新会话。

subagentModelSelectionPartial.en: Some model providers could not be loaded; saved choices remain removable.
subagentModelSelectionPartial.zh: 部分模型提供方暂时无法加载；已保存的选择仍可移除。

subagentModelSelectionEmpty.en: No model provider currently advertises a model.
subagentModelSelectionEmpty.zh: 当前没有模型提供方公布模型。

subagentModelSelectionRequired.en: Select at least one model before saving.
subagentModelSelectionRequired.zh: 保存前请至少选择一个模型。

subagentModelSelectionConflict.en: Settings changed elsewhere. Discard your draft and try again.
subagentModelSelectionConflict.zh: 设置已在其他位置更新。请放弃修改后重试。

subagentModelSelectionOff.en: Subagents use configured defaults or inherit the parent agent's model. Saved model choices are retained.
subagentModelSelectionOff.zh: 关闭后，子智能体使用配置的默认模型或继承父 Agent 的模型；已选模型会保留。

description.en: Set up the DeepSeek search provider.
description.zh: 设置 DeepSeek 的搜索提供方。

apiKeyHint.en: Stored outside the settings file. Leave blank to keep the current key.
apiKeyHint.zh: 不写入设置文件。留空表示保持当前密钥。

apiKeyUnset.en: No key is configured; search is unavailable until one is.
apiKeyUnset.zh: 未配置密钥；配置之前搜索不可用。

baseUrlHint.en: Leave blank to use the provider default.
baseUrlHint.zh: 留空则使用提供方默认地址。

maxUses.zh: 单次请求最多搜索次数

maxUsesHint.en: How many times one request may search before it must answer.
maxUsesHint.zh: 一次请求在必须作答前最多可以搜索多少次。

unavailable.en: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
unavailable.zh: 该插件当前未加载，暂时无法配置。

saveFailed.en: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
saveFailed.zh: 本部署没有接受这些值，已保留供你修改。

invalidNumber.en: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
invalidNumber.zh: 请填数字；留空表示使用默认值。

record-help.en: Release the keys to save. Tab moves between actions; Esc cancels.
record-help.zh: 松开组合键即保存。Tab 切换操作，Esc 退出录键。

web-help.en: Browser combinations: Mod+/, Mod+Shift+,, Mod+Shift+.. Mod is Command on Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.
web-help.zh: 浏览器可用组合：Mod+/、Mod+Shift+,、Mod+Shift+.。Mod 在 Mac 上为 Command，其他系统为 Ctrl。

reserved.en: This combination is reserved for system or text editing actions.
reserved.zh: 此组合由系统或文本编辑操作保留。

modifier-required.en: Include Command, Ctrl, or Alt in the combination.
modifier-required.zh: 请同时按下 Command、Ctrl 或 Alt 修饰键。

too-many-keys.en: Hold at most two non-modifier keys. Release the keys to try again.
too-many-keys.zh: 最多同时按下两个非修饰键。请松开后重试。

macos-web-help.en: Use Command+/, Command+,, Command+Backslash, Control+Backquote, Command+Option+key, or Command+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
macos-web-help.zh: 可设置 Command+/、Command+,、Command+反斜杠、Control+反引号、Command+Option+按键或 Command+Shift+按键。也支持三个或四个不同修饰键的组合。浏览器或系统占用的组合可能无法送达页面。

windows-web-help.en: Use Ctrl+/, Ctrl+,, Ctrl+Alt+key, or Ctrl+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
windows-web-help.zh: 可设置 Ctrl+/、Ctrl+,、Ctrl+Alt+按键或 Ctrl+Shift+按键。也支持三个或四个不同修饰键的组合。浏览器或系统占用的组合可能无法送达页面。

unsupported-browser.en: This browser does not support this combination yet.
unsupported-browser.zh: 此浏览器暂不支持该组合。

reset-description.en: Restore the default shortcuts for this platform. All modified or removed shortcuts will be restored. Other platforms are unaffected.
reset-description.zh: 将恢复当前平台的默认快捷键。你修改或移除的快捷键都会恢复，其他平台不受影响。

reset-failed.en: Could not restore defaults. Your shortcuts are unchanged. Please retry.
reset-failed.zh: 恢复默认失败。原快捷键已保留，请重试。

review.en: I have reviewed the latest configuration

stale.en: Shortcut configuration or available commands changed. Review the latest bindings before saving.
stale.zh: 快捷键配置或可用命令已更新。请核对最新键位后再保存。

write-failed.en: Could not save. Your previous shortcuts and current draft are preserved. Please retry.
write-failed.zh: 保存失败。原快捷键和当前草稿已保留，请重试。

not-ready.en: Shortcuts are not ready. Please try again.
not-ready.zh: 快捷键尚未准备好，请稍后重试。

read.en: Could not read {location}. Check access permissions, then {reload}.
read.zh: 无法读取 {location}。请检查访问权限后{reload}。

invalid.en: Shortcut configuration in {location} is damaged. Back up and repair this configuration, then {reload}.
invalid.zh: {location} 的快捷键配置内容损坏。请先备份并修复该配置，然后{reload}。

future.en: Shortcut configuration in {location} was created by a newer version. Upgrade Harness and try again.
future.zh: {location} 的快捷键配置由更新版本创建。请升级 Harness 后重试。

web-document.zh: 当前网站本地存储中的 dsh.keybindings.v1

using-accepted.en: The last successfully read bindings remain active.
using-accepted.zh: 当前继续使用上次读取成功的键位。

native-failed.en: Could not protect desktop key recording. Exit recording and try again.
native-failed.zh: 无法启用桌面录键保护，请关闭后重试。

description.en: View and edit available shortcuts and input actions
description.zh: 查看和编辑当前可用的快捷键和输入操作

load.failed.en: The page could not load; reload or open it in the system browser.
load.failed.zh: 页面加载失败；请刷新重试或在系统浏览器中打开。

address.unknown.en: The page navigated; this carrier cannot read its new URL.
address.unknown.zh: 页面已跳转；当前载体无法读取新的 URL。

viewMissingFonts.zh: 缺失 {count} 种字体，点击查看

invalid.en: This spreadsheet could not be opened. Check its format, contents, or password protection.
invalid.zh: 无法打开此表格。请检查文件格式、内容或密码保护。

tooLarge.en: This workbook exceeds the preview size limit.
tooLarge.zh: 此表格超过预览大小限制。

timeout.en: Opening this workbook timed out. Try a smaller file.
timeout.zh: 打开表格超时。请缩小文件后重试。

encoding.en: This text encoding could not be read. Save the file as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a BOM and retry.
encoding.zh: 无法识别此文本文件的编码。请另存为 UTF-8 或带 BOM 的 UTF-16 后重试。

formulaWarning.en: This workbook contains formulas. Displayed results may be missing or inaccurate.
formulaWarning.zh: 此工作簿包含公式，显示结果可能缺失或不准确。

unsupportedNotice.en: This preview does not support {features} in this workbook. Open it in a system application for the full experience.
unsupportedNotice.zh: 当前预览不支持此工作簿中的{features}。请使用系统应用打开，以获得完整体验。

command.noFocus.en: Focus a right sidebar pane first

command.stale.en: The page changed; focus it again
command.stale.zh: 页面已切换，请重新聚焦

command.float.en: This action is unavailable in a floating panel
command.float.zh: 浮动面板不支持此操作

command.width.en: Not enough width to split, widen the sidebar
command.width.zh: 栏宽不足，拖宽侧边栏后再分栏

readonly.unknown.body.en: Read the child session to determine whether it can be continued.
readonly.unknown.body.zh: 读取子会话后才能确定是否可继续。

layout.toolsChanged.zh: 新增 {added} 个，移除 {removed} 个

defaultWorkspace.failed.en: Unable to create default workspace. Use Choose workspace to select a folder.
defaultWorkspace.failed.zh: 无法创建默认工作区，请通过“选择工作区”选择文件夹

shortcut.directoryBusy.zh: 正在选择或添加工作区

shortcut.noCompletedTurn.en: This session has no completed turn
shortcut.noCompletedTurn.zh: 当前会话没有已结束的轮次

shortcut.forkFailed.en: Could not fork the session. Try again.

toast.archivedNotOpenable.en: Archived sessions cannot be opened. Unarchive it to view.
toast.archivedNotOpenable.zh: 已归档对话暂时无法查看，请取消归档后查看

toast.stoppedAndArchived.en: Session stopped and archived. You can

archive.confirm.desc.en: “{title}” still has work in progress. Archiving stops it first; you can restore the session later from the “All conversations (show archived)” filter in the sidebar, and the stopped work will not resume on its own.
archive.confirm.desc.zh: “{title}”仍有正在进行的工作。归档会先停止这些工作；之后可在侧栏筛选“全部对话（显示已归档）”中恢复会话，被停止的工作不会自动继续。

toast.unpinFailed.zh: 取消置顶失败，请稍后重试

setupPrompt.title.en: Set up voice input before recording
setupPrompt.title.zh: 使用语音输入前需要安装

setupPrompt.body.en: Voice input is enabled. First use requires downloading and preparing local recognition models. Open the plugin details to review disk space, memory and time estimates before starting setup.
setupPrompt.body.zh: 语音输入插件已开启。首次使用需要在本机下载并准备识别模型，请前往插件详情页查看空间、内存和时间说明，再开始安装。

setupPrompt.unavailableBody.en: Open the voice plugin details to check recognition status, preparation progress, or errors.
setupPrompt.unavailableBody.zh: 请前往语音插件详情页查看识别服务状态、准备进度或错误信息

setup.local.en: Local models will be downloaded to the machine running DSH. No Python or compiler is required.
setup.local.zh: 将在运行 DSH 的机器上下载本地模型，无需安装 Python 或编译工具。

setup.diskValue.en: Allow about {gb} GB for models, runtime, and download caches
setup.diskValue.zh: 建议预留约 {gb} GB，包含模型、运行时和下载缓存

setup.memoryValue.en: About {gb} GB with the model loaded; recognition may use more
setup.memoryValue.zh: 模型加载后约 {gb} GB，识别时可能更高

setup.timeValue.en: Allow roughly {min}–{max} minutes, depending on the network and machine
setup.timeValue.zh: 参考 {min}–{max} 分钟，取决于网络和机器性能

setup.estimateNote.en: These are estimates; slow networks may take longer. Downloads are reused; idle models release memory by default.
setup.estimateNote.zh: 以上为估算；网络较慢时可能更久。已下载的资源会复用，默认在闲置后释放模型内存。

download.network.en: Cannot download {resource}: connection to the download service failed.
download.network.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：连接下载服务失败。

download.dns.en: Cannot download {resource}: the download address could not be resolved.
download.dns.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：无法解析下载地址。

download.certificate.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：安全连接的证书校验失败。

download.http.en: Cannot download {resource}: the download service returned HTTP {status}.
download.http.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：下载服务返回 HTTP {status}。

download.integrity.en: The download of {resource} is incomplete or failed verification.
download.integrity.zh: {resource} 下载不完整或文件校验失败。

download.storage.en: Cannot save {resource}: insufficient disk space or write permission.
download.storage.zh: 无法保存 {resource}：磁盘空间不足或没有写入权限。

downloadAdvice.network.en: Check that the machine running DSH can reach the download source and its model download services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed, then retry.
downloadAdvice.network.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器能否访问下载来源及其模型下载服务；如需代理，请在该机器上配置后重试。

downloadAdvice.dns.en: Check DNS and proxy settings on the machine running DSH. Confirm that it can resolve the download source domain, then retry.
downloadAdvice.dns.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的 DNS 和代理设置，确认可以解析下载来源的域名后重试。

downloadAdvice.timeout.en: Check the network or proxy connection on the machine running DSH, then retry later. Verified downloaded files are retained.
downloadAdvice.timeout.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的网络或代理连接，稍后重试。已下载并通过校验的文件会保留。

downloadAdvice.certificate.en: Check the system clock, trusted certificates and proxy settings on the machine running DSH, then retry.
downloadAdvice.certificate.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的系统时间、受信任证书和代理设置后重试。

downloadAdvice.http.en: Confirm that the download address is available and the proxy can reach the download service, or retry later.
downloadAdvice.http.zh: 请确认下载地址可用、代理可正常连接下载服务，或稍后重试。

downloadAdvice.integrity.en: Retry the download. Other completed and verified files are retained.
downloadAdvice.integrity.zh: 请重试下载。已完成并通过校验的其他文件会保留。

downloadAdvice.storage.en: Check available disk space and write permission for the model directory on the machine running DSH, then retry.
downloadAdvice.storage.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的剩余磁盘空间，以及模型目录的写入权限后重试。

downloadAdvice.unknown.en: Check the network, disk space and model directory permissions on the machine running DSH, then retry.
downloadAdvice.unknown.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的网络、磁盘空间和模型目录权限后重试。

sourceAutoHelp.en: Prefer the first responding source and try another if a download fails.
sourceAutoHelp.zh: 优先使用响应较快的源，下载失败时自动尝试其他源。

sourceManualHelp.en: Download only from the selected source. Verified downloaded files are reused.
sourceManualHelp.zh: 仅从所选源下载；已下载并通过校验的文件会复用。

preparation.unprepared.en: First use downloads the local recognition models.
preparation.unprepared.zh: 首次使用需要下载本地识别模型。

preparation.standby.en: Local resources are prepared. Recording wakes the recognizer.
preparation.standby.zh: 本地资源已准备，录音时自动唤醒。

preparation.cancelled.en: Preparation cancelled. Completed downloads are retained.
preparation.cancelled.zh: 准备已取消，已完成的下载会保留。

interrupted.en: Recording was interrupted. Please try again.

local.en: Audio is recognized on the machine running DSH. If models need downloading, that machine must be able to reach the selected source and its file services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed.
local.zh: 音频在运行 DSH 的机器上识别。需要下载模型时，请确保该机器能访问所选下载源及其文件服务。如需代理，请在该机器上配置。

cloud.en: Audio will be sent to the selected cloud service.
cloud.zh: 音频将发送至所选云端服务。

conflict.en: Your draft changed. The transcript is preserved and can be inserted at the current cursor.
conflict.zh: 草稿已被修改。识别文字已保留，可在当前光标位置插入。

unavailable.en: This browser cannot record audio. Use a browser with microphone support.
unavailable.zh: 当前浏览器不支持录音，请使用支持麦克风的浏览器。

permission.en: Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings.
permission.zh: 麦克风权限未开启，请在浏览器和系统设置中允许访问。

tooLarge.en: The recording exceeds the service limit. Try a shorter recording.
tooLarge.zh: 录音超过服务限制，请缩短录音后重试。

sectionIntro.en: Choose the agent’s tools and how it works. Use Standard mode for everyday tasks, or Creator mode to add capabilities to DSH.
sectionIntro.wasEn: A preset is the plugin composition one session's agent runs — its tools, prompt, and capabilities. Duplicate an existing one and make it yours, or let the agent draft one for you in Creator mode.
sectionIntro.currentIt: Un preset è la composizione di Plugin con cui gira l'agente di una sessione: i suoi strumenti, il suo prompt e le sue capacità. Duplicane uno esistente e personalizzalo, oppure lascia che l'agente ne abbozzi uno per te in modalità Creator.

seatHint.en: Choose the agent preset for your new task
seatHint.wasEn: Agent preset for the session you are about to start
seatHint.currentIt: Preset dell'agente per la sessione che stai per avviare

headerHint.en: The agent preset chosen when this task started
headerHint.wasEn: The agent preset this session runs, fixed when it started
headerHint.currentIt: Il preset dell'agente con cui gira questa sessione, fissato all'avvio

presetStandardDescription.en: Work with code, files, and information. Suitable for most tasks, with search, editing, terminal commands, and other tools available as needed.
presetStandardDescription.wasEn: Full coding agent with file editing, shell, file and web search, skills, planning, goals, subagents, and workflows.
presetStandardDescription.currentIt: Agente di codifica completo con modifica dei file, shell, ricerca su file e web, Skill, pianificazione, obiettivi, subagenti e Workflow.

presetPtcDescription.en: Includes all Standard mode capabilities. Better suited to tasks that call tools in batches and then filter, organize, deduplicate, count, or summarize the results.
presetPtcDescription.wasEn: Full coding agent without the workflow tool; other tools are exposed through the PTC mode SDK so the model can combine multi-step operations in one TypeScript program.
presetPtcDescription.currentIt: Agente di codifica completo senza lo strumento workflow; gli altri strumenti sono esposti tramite l'SDK della modalità PTC, così il modello può combinare operazioni multi-passo in un unico programma TypeScript.

presetMinimalDescription.en: The agent works using only a terminal tool. Useful for testing and comparing its basic performance.
presetMinimalDescription.wasEn: Single-tool coding agent with a persistent shell.
presetMinimalDescription.currentIt: Agente di codifica con un solo strumento e una shell persistente.

presetCordisDescription.en: Customize DSH through conversation. Let the agent write plugins that add features or UI, or combine tools and prompts to create your own mode.
presetCordisDescription.wasEn: Built for creating custom agent presets, with all Standard mode capabilities plus runtime inspection, persistent plugin management, and preset-authoring guidance.
presetCordisDescription.currentIt: Pensata per creare preset di agenti personalizzati: offre tutte le capacità della modalità standard più l'ispezione a runtime, la gestione persistente dei Plugin e le linee guida per la creazione dei preset.

creatorDraft.en: Let the agent help me create a preset
creatorDraft.wasEn: Draft a custom preset with Creator mode
creatorDraft.currentIt: Abbozza un preset personalizzato con la modalità Creator

settings.transcript.description.en: Choose how much detail to show for tool calls
settings.transcript.description.wasEn: Controls process content in completed turns
settings.transcript.description.currentIt: Controlla il contenuto di processo nei turni completati

auto.confirm.description.en: Auto review runs without a sandbox. Before every native tool call and PTC inner call, the same model as the current agent reviews whether to allow it; you approve or reject each call it denies. This feature is experimental, can falsely allow or deny actions, and uses additional tokens.
auto.confirm.description.wasEn: Auto review runs without a sandbox. Before every native tool call and PTC inner call, the same model as the current agent reviews whether to allow it. This feature is experimental, can falsely allow or deny actions, and uses additional tokens.
auto.confirm.description.currentIt: Auto review viene eseguito senza sandbox. Prima di ogni chiamata a strumento nativa e di ogni chiamata interna PTC, lo stesso modello dell'agente corrente valuta se consentirla. La funzione è sperimentale, può autorizzare o negare azioni per errore e consuma token aggiuntivi.

error.en: Could not read all plugins, possibly due to a network problem

installGuideIdHint.en: The plugin package name is the npm package name (like dsh-xxx or @author/plugin): the part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in a community plugin's README install command.
installGuideIdHint.wasEn: The part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in the README's install command.
installGuideIdHint.currentIt: La parte che segue dsh plugin add o pnpm add nel comando di installazione del README.

deepSeekEndpointHint.en: Use an API endpoint compatible with Anthropic Messages.
deepSeekEndpointHint.wasEn: Use an endpoint compatible with the configured connection.
deepSeekEndpointHint.currentIt: Usa un endpoint compatibile con la connessione configurata.

advancedHint.en: Other fields live in cordis.patch.yml; edit that section directly.
advancedHint.wasEn: Other fields live in settings.yaml; edit that section directly.
advancedHint.currentIt: Gli altri campi si trovano in settings.yaml; modifica direttamente quella sezione.

empty.en: No shared tasks yet. Create them through the conversation.
